contexts.text: Waters and rivers = difficulties; also, falsities.
(Such) can with difficulty, if ever, be brought to receive truths...
A difficult word they will bring to Moses () = mediation and intercession.

It is evident that it is not so difficult as many believe, to enter the way of Heaven. The only difficulty is, to be able to resist the love of self and the world, and to prevent their predominance. Signified.
That it is not so difficult to lead the life which leads to Heaven, as is believed. General article.
The difficulty of so thinking, and likewise of resisting evils, increases in proportion as man from the will commits evils...
That the way is narrow which leads to life is not because it is difficult; but because there are few who find it.
This life (of charity) is not difficult; but a life of piety abstracted from a life of charity is difficult...
Concerning the difficult reception of the doctrine of the New Church. Signified. AR 535.
These dogmas can only be learned with great difficulty.
Thus (He rules the universe) without any difficulty.
How difficultly man can be persuaded...
It is not grievous and difficult...
That to live as a Christian is not difficult in the heavenly doctrine...
That spiritual truths and goods... can only be received with the greatest difficulty. Signified.
